# Twin Space Studio

> Residential and commercial interior design studio based in Mahalunge, Baner, Pune, India, serving Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC). Full-service design, turnkey execution and styling, typically 10-12 weeks from concept to completion, quoted line by line before work begins.

Founded by Pooja Dhoot and Dimple Marathe. A full 2 BHK interior runs INR 12-16 lakh and a full 3 BHK INR 16-21 lakh; 4 BHK and duplex projects are quoted on scope. The figure quoted on day one is the figure at handover. Work runs through six stages: Discover, Conceptualize, Design & plan, Select & finalize, Execute, Deliver & stylize.

## Services

- [Turnkey interior design and execution](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/turnkey-interiors): one contract covering design, materials, procurement, all site work, supervision and handover.
- [Modular kitchen design](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/modular-kitchens): layouts, shutter materials, counters, internal storage and ventilation.
- [Wardrobes and storage](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/wardrobes-storage): sliding versus openable, internal layouts, bespoke furniture and customized beds.
- [False ceilings and lighting](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/false-ceilings-lighting): gypsum and slatted ceilings, cove and profile lighting, smart home wiring.
- [2 BHK interior design in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/2-bhk-interior-design): what a full 2 BHK costs and where the budget goes.
- [3 BHK interior design in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/3-bhk-interior-design): what a full 3 BHK costs and how to plan the third room.

## Areas served

- [Areas we serve across Pune and PCMC](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas-we-serve): the twenty areas we work in, with local housing context for each.
- [Interior designers in Baner](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/baner): 3 BHK, 4 BHK and duplex homes; society and service-lift rules.
- [Interior designers in Kharadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/kharadi): new possession towers near EON IT Park and WTC.
- [Interior designers in Balewadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/balewadi): gated townships near Balewadi High Street.
- [Interior designers in Kothrud](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/kothrud): established societies, renovations and redevelopments.
- [Interior designers in Punawale](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/punawale): complete 2 BHK fit-outs from bare builder handover.
- [Interior designers in Kondhwa](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/kondhwa): larger-format 3 and 4 BHK homes and zoning.

Also covers Wakad, Hinjawadi, Koregaon Park, Viman Nagar, Kalyani Nagar, Aundh, Mahalunge, Bavdhan, Sus, Pashan, Tathawade, Erandwane, Mundhwa, Hadapsar, Magarpatta City and Pimple Saudagar.

## Completed projects

- [3 BHK duplex, Baner](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/baner-duplex): marble, teak slats and brass carried across two levels.
- [3 BHK, Dahanukar Colony, Kothrud](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/kothrud-3bhk): art-led home with a pooja unit at the entry and a window study nook.
- [4 BHK, Escon, Kondhwa](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/kondhwa-4bhk): dining under a slatted timber ceiling in an open plan.
- [3 BHK, Kharadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/kharadi-3bhk): arched detailing repeated from foyer to guest bedroom.
- [2 BHK, Balewadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/balewadi-2bhk): kitchen opened into the living room.
- [2 BHK, Punawale](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/punawale-2bhk): living and dining planned together from a bare handover.
